# RweruSynapse

> RweruSynapse (RWERU) is a Rwanda-based technology company building practical software, advancing applied AI, and growing Africa's next generation of builders.

RWERU is the short public brand; RweruSynapse is the official company name. Brand structure:

- RWERU Studio — client services: custom software and digital platforms
- RWERU Products — software we own and operate, starting with Masata
- RWERU Labs — applied research and AI experiments
- RWERU Community — learning, events, and community programs for African builders

## Pages

- [Home](https://rweru.com/): Overview of RweruSynapse and what we build
- [Products](https://rweru.com/products): RWERU Products, starting with Masata
- [Solutions](https://rweru.com/solutions): RWERU Studio — custom software for organizations across Rwanda and Africa
- [Research](https://rweru.com/research): RWERU Labs — applied research and AI experiments
- [Work](https://rweru.com/use-cases): Client work delivered by RWERU Studio
- [Community](https://rweru.com/community): RWERU Community, where Africans learn and contribute to software together
- [Company](https://rweru.com/company): About RweruSynapse, our team, and our mission
- [Blog](https://rweru.com/blog): Notes on engineering, research, and community from RweruSynapse
- [Contact](https://rweru.com/contact): Get in touch with RweruSynapse

- [Masata](https://masata.app): Masata by RWERU — a product of RweruSynapse
